A hands-on workshop on using [Containerlab](https://containerlab.dev) for networking labs.

**Lab manuals:** work through the parts in order. The lab files are in the workshop repository:
[github.com/aghufran/dynanet-dev](https://github.com/aghufran/dynanet-dev/tree/main/clab-workshop), in the `clab-workshop` folder.

| Part | Topic | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Installing Containerlab | Available |
| 2 | Loading network OS images into Docker | Available |
| 3 | Writing a lab topology file | Available |
| 4 | Connecting to the nodes in a lab | Available |
| 5 | Running a lab across several hosts (VXLAN) | Available |

**What you need:** an Ubuntu host with 4 vCPUs and 16 GB of RAM. The routers in Parts 2 to 5 run Cisco IOS XR, as the
Cisco XRd container image. You get that image from Cisco with your own account; Part 2 shows how to load it.

To see any lab in the workshop, or one of your own, as a diagram, paste its topology file into the
[topology viewer](https://graphs.dynanet.dev/topology).
